Synthetic Platforms Reports Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Results

MENLO PARK, Calif. – January 28, 2026 – Synthetic Platforms, Inc. today reported financial results for the quarter and full year ended December 31, 2025.

Fourth Quarter 2025 Financial Highlights

Total costs and expenses were $29.70 billion, an increase of 25% year-over-year. Our fourth quarter 2025 results include legal-related charges of $2.40 billion, recorded in general and administrative expenses. In the fourth quarter of 2025, we recorded severance and related personnel costs of $1.18 billion in connection with a workforce reduction.

Capital expenditures, including principal payments on finance leases, were $14.84 billion for the fourth quarter of 2025.

First Quarter 2026 Business Outlook

We expect first quarter 2026 total revenue to be in the range of $41.5-44.5 billion. We expect restructuring charges of $0.3 billion in the first quarter of 2026.
